orders.order: “I'm hosting a fancy dinner party tonight, so make me a pizza with prosciutto, fig, and a touch of basil. No sauce. I'll take two of them.”
orders.clarification: “Prosciutto is the fanciest ham there is, and figs are the fanciest fruit. Make them cheesy, sauceless, and don't forget the basil.”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Basil + Corn + Chicken + Fig

orders.order: “My favorite meal is fried chicken with corn and basil, plus sweet figs to balance the flavors.”
orders.clarification: “Let's see, that would be...chicken, corn, basil, and figs!”

entries.recipe: Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Pineapple + Jalapeno + Fig

orders.order: “Once upon a time a dragon blew fire onto a cheesy pesto pizza with figs, jalapenos, and pineapple. It was the best pizza ever. The end.”
orders.clarification: “One pesto pizza with figs, pineapple, and jalapeno. Don't forget cheese!”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Sausage + Bacon + Ham] [Sauce + Cheese + Basil + Jalapeno] [Sauce + Cheese + Eggplant + Fig]

orders.order: “I'd like one pie with figs and eggplant, one pie with basil and jalapenos, and one pie with pork! Sauce and cheese on all three.”
orders.clarification: “That'll be three cheese pizzas, please. One pork pizza, one with jalapenos and basil, the other with figs and eggplant!”

entries.recipe: Tomato Sauce + Cheese + Chicken + Sliced Tomato + Jalapeno + Fig

orders.order: “Have you ever tried a jalapeno chicken casserole with figs and tomatoes? Not even with cheese and red sauce? You're missing out!”
orders.clarification: “Make my pizza like I make my favorite casserole, but make sure to add red sauce and cheese.”

orders.order: “Can I get a grilled cheese with fig? Use dough instead of bread. And add sliced tomato!”
orders.clarification: “Cheese on dough with fig and sliced tomato! No sauce.”

orders.order: “Imagine there's no red sauce... It's easy if you try. Just cheese and zucchini... Below them only pie.”
orders.clarification: “Sorry, I get carried away with my singing sometimes. I just want a cheese and zucchini flatbread.”

orders.order: “I'm having a sleepover tonight! Gimme a cheesy flatbread with courgette.”
orders.clarification: “Oh! Courgette is another word for zucchini. I don't want any sauce. Add it to yummy cheese on dough!”

orders.order: “I just found out Doughio has a four-day festival dedicated to celebrating zucchinis. I'm booking my flight ASAP!”
orders.clarification: “Zucchini, sauce, and cheese. That's all!”

orders.order: “What did the zucchini say to the sausage who stepped on him?”
orders.clarification: “SQUASH! ... Ahem...just sauce, cheese, zucchini, and sausage, please.”

orders.order: “I've got a fever! And the only prescription is bell pepper! My pharmacist also told me to eat more zucchini with sauce, but to stay away from cheese.”
orders.clarification: “Bell pepper, zucchini, sauce. No cheese.”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Eggplant + Bacon + Corn + Zucchini] x2

orders.order: “What's better than an eggplant pizza with corn, zucchini, bacon, cheese, and sauce? Two of them!”
orders.clarification: “I want two cheese pizzas and each one should have eggplant, zucchini, corn, and bacon!”

orders.order: “Did you know Italy is the home of pizza AND zucchini? I can't say the same about garlic and chicken, but they all taste great together!”
orders.clarification: “I'll take a cheese pizza with chicken and garlic. Don't forget the zucchini!”

orders.order: “If you could make your dream meal, what would it be? Mine would be a dark flatbread with sliced tomato, zucchini, and olive.”
orders.clarification: “I hope my dream comes true with a sliced tomato, zucchini, and olive flatbread. Bake it twice.”
orders.note: (Run the pizza through the oven twice.)

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Mushroom + Onion + Sliced Tomato + Zucchini

orders.order: “Where would I be if I were a zucchini, and my best friends were onions, mushrooms, and sliced tomatoes?”
orders.clarification: “Answer: on top of cheese and sauce!”

entries.recipe: [Pesto Sauce + Bacon + Jalapeno] [(Tomato Sauce + Cheese) + (Pesto Sauce + Zucchini)]

orders.order: “My first pizza should have only cheese on the red sauce half and zucchini on the green sauce half. The other pizza should have green sauce and a smattering of bacon and jalapenos, but no cheese.”
orders.clarification: “One pizza that is half pesto and zucchini, half red sauce and cheese. The other should have pesto, bacon, and jalapenos.”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Olive + Anchovy] [Sauce + Cheese + Jalapeno + Zucchini]

orders.order: “I'll need a Salty Sailor and one "zucchinapeno" pizza!”
orders.clarification: “You know what I mean. One zucchini and jalapeno. One Salty Sailor. With sauce and cheese.”

entries.recipe: [Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Onion + Anchovy] [Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Bell Pepper + Basil] [Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Onion + Jalapeno + Zucchini]

orders.order: “Gimme one Green Dream, one Stinky Pete, and one onion zucchini jalapeno pie. Pesto on all three!”
orders.clarification: “Three pizzas with pesto and cheese. One of them should have onions, zucchini, and jalapeno. One of them should be a Green Dream. The other, a Stinky Pete.”

orders.order: “My heart is aching for pizza! My artichoke heart that is.”
orders.clarification: “Let's keep it simple. I just want artichoke hearts, sauce, and cheese.”

orders.order: “Technically, this vegetable is just a flower that hasn't bloomed yet. Let the flavor bloom on a pesto cheese pizza!”
orders.clarification: “One artichoke pizza with pesto sauce!”

orders.order: “Artichokes were once banned in Dough York for three days because the mafia monopolized them. In honor of those three days, I'll take three artichoke pizzas!”
orders.clarification: “Three pizzas with artichokes, sauce, and cheese, of course.”

orders.order: “When I was a kid, my older sister told me artichokes were dragon eggs, and onions made people cry because they were fossilized dragon tears.”
orders.clarification: “I think I still believe her. Use both of those ingredients with sauce and cheese, please!”

orders.order: “I had a dream that a giant artichoke and a giant anchovy fought each other like King Kong and Godzilla. In the end, our city burnt to a crisp.”
orders.clarification: “Sauce and cheese with artichoke hearts and anchovies! Make it extra crispy, please!”
orders.note: (Run the pizza through the oven twice.)

orders.order: “Historians say that artichokes were first cultivated in 800 AD. But have they ever been combined with pepperoni and anchovies? Let's make history!”
orders.clarification: “Artichoke hearts, pepperoni, and anchovies. Add sauce and cheese, please.”

orders.order: “I caught a whiff of your grilled chicken and crispy bacon, and I thought they would taste great with cheesy artichokes!”
orders.clarification: “Just a cheese pizza with artichokes, chicken, and bacon.”

orders.order: “According to mythology, a god named Zeus turned a mortal woman into an artichoke. What's next, turning a man into a clove of garlic?”
orders.clarification: “Artichoke, garlic, sauce, and cheese, please!”

orders.order: “Artichokes were considered food for ancient gods. If I were one, I'd consider garlic and shrimp just as divine!”
orders.clarification: “One cheese pizza with garlic, shrimp, and artichoke hearts.”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Basil + Garlic + Sliced Tomato + Artichoke

orders.order: “In the Middle Ages, artichokes were only supposed to be eaten by royalty. Tomato, garlic, and basil are just as classy if you ask me.”
orders.clarification: “So for the toppings, you should use sliced tomato, garlic, basil, and artichoke hearts. Oh, and use cheese and sauce, too!”

orders.order: “I want four-eighths of my pizza to have zucchini and artichoke. The other four-eighths should have pepperoni. Oh, and don't reduce the fraction.”
orders.clarification: “Cut my pizza into eight slices. Add zucchini and artichoke to half of it and pepperoni to the other!”
orders.note: (Cut the pizza into eight slices.)

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Sausage + Mushroom + Olive + Ham + Artichoke

orders.order: “I'm so hungry! Please combine Classic Meat and Capricciosa toppings on one pizza!”
orders.clarification: “Top a cheese pizza with pepperoni, sausage, mushroom, olive, ham, and artichoke!”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Sausage + Bacon + Ham + Artichoke] x2

orders.order: “I wish I could eat four pizzas myself, but I can't. Make half that amount with artichoke and pork on top.”
orders.clarification: “I can only eat two pizzas. Put artichoke and pork on them, please.”

orders.order: “I'm picky... I don't like sauce... or cheese... but I want pumpkin. Can you just put that on some dough, please?”
orders.clarification: “Literally, just pumpkin on cooked dough. I really don't like sauce or cheese.”

orders.order: “Last night, I had a dream I was riding in a pumpkin carriage to meet my true love! Then the clock struck 12 and woke me up. But it left me craving a pumpkin pizza!”
orders.clarification: “I don't know how a pumpkin turns into a carriage, but I'm sure a simple pumpkin pizza will be just as magical!”

orders.order: “I think I want a...wait, what if I get a...hm...what do I want...? Oh! A pumpkin pizza.”
orders.clarification: “Yeah, I definitely want a pumpkin pizza. Sorry, I was a bit indecisive for a second there.”

orders.order: “The truth is out there. In a flying saucer of pumpkin pizza.”
orders.clarification: “I want to see what delicious secrets lies in a pizza with sauce, cheese, and pumpkin!”

orders.order: “I'm taking a nutrition class, and now I'm confused. Is pumpkin a vegetable or a fruit? Does it matter if it's going on pizza? Does that make it a grain instead? I can check off all three categories if I order a pumpkin pizza!”
orders.clarification: “It's a standard cheese pizza with pumpkin on top!”

orders.order: “Did you know every part of the pumpkin is edible? From the seeds to the stem! Make me a pizza with the delicious topping, please.”
orders.clarification: “What parts of the pumpkin do you use? Wait, don't tell me. I want to be surprised! One pumpkin pizza, please.”

orders.order: “You have pumpkin? Sweet! I'll take a pumpkin pizza!”
orders.clarification: “It's a cheese pizza, but toss on some pumpkin.”

orders.order: “I want to get a pumpkin pizza for my pumpkin!”
orders.clarification: “I call my friend "pumpkin" just for fun, ha! Make a pumpkin pizza for them, will you?”

orders.order: “I heard cucurbits make for great pizza toppings. They're things like gourds or squash. Can I have a pizza with them?”
orders.clarification: “You know, Cucurbitaceae! Like pumpkin and zucchini!”

orders.order: “Ahhh, there's nothing like getting cozy with a freshly baked pumpkin pie during the season!”
orders.clarification: “All I want is to sit on my couch and cuddle up with pumpkin on a cheese pizza. Doesn't that sound wonderful?”

orders.order: “I want a fruity autumn topping I can share with my cat!”
orders.clarification: “I read that pumpkin in small portions is a good treat for them!”

orders.order: “Does pesto and pumpkin sound like a weird combination? I'd like to try it please.”
orders.clarification: “A regular pumpkin pizza with pesto sauce instead of tomato sauce!”

orders.order: “Two pumpkin pies, please! And I don't mean the dessert.”
orders.clarification: “I'm really craving a cheese pizza with pumpkin. Actually, I'm craving two!”

orders.order: “I've never had pumpkin on pizza before. Put it on half of my pizza, just in case I don't like it. Mushrooms on the other half.”
orders.clarification: “I want a cheese pizza with half pumpkin and half mushroom.”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Pumpkin] [Sauce + Cheese + Sausage + Pumpkin] [Sauce + Cheese + Olive + Onion + Pumpkin]

orders.order: “My siblings and I want to settle a bet. I think pumpkin is the best with olives and onions, my sister likes it with sausage, and the other just likes it by itself. Make the pizzas, and we'll see who's right.”
orders.clarification: “One pumpkin pizza with olives and onions. Another with pumpkin and sausage. The last with just pumpkin. All with sauce and cheese!”

orders.order: “I'm gonna need a pumpkin pizza. Add basil for a bit of extra flavor!”
orders.clarification: “I think pumpkin and basil would pair well together.”

orders.order: “Peking duck is my favorite meal! I like it with steamed buns. Make me a crispy duck flatbread to emulate the delicious dish!”
orders.clarification: “All I need is a flatbread with duck on top. Fire it up twice for extra crispiness!”
orders.note: (Run the pizza through the oven twice.)

orders.order: “Duck! Double pizzas, double-baked!”
orders.clarification: “Two pizzas with duck! Fire it up twice!”
orders.note: (Run the pizza through the oven twice.)

orders.order: “Quack quack quack!”
orders.clarification: “Get it? That was a duck sound! I basically said I need three duck pizzas.”

orders.order: “Pep and duck. That's it. That's the order.”
orders.clarification: “I want pepperoni and duck on a cheese pizza.”

orders.order: “I want duck and sausage right now!”
orders.clarification: “A cheese pizza with duck and sausage. Please.”

orders.order: “I'd like a half-and-half pizza. Different sauces on each side. Mushroom and duck on different sides. Mushroom and pesto on the same side.”
orders.clarification: “Half pesto and mushroom, half duck and tomato sauce. Cheese all over!”

orders.order: “I think eggplant is bad for ducks, so I'll get them on separate sides of my pizza. Red sauce on the duck side, please!”
orders.clarification: “Duck and tomato sauce on one side, eggplant and any sauce on the other. Don't skimp on the cheese, either!”

orders.order: “Duck bathed in tomato sauce and cheese sounds absolutely delightful if corn pizza is its neighbor.”
orders.clarification: “Half duck on tomato sauce with cheese, half corn pizza, thanks.”

orders.order: “Ever heard of a Turducken before? Gimme that minus the turkey.”
orders.clarification: “It's a chicken, stuffed in a duck, stuffed in a turkey. But I only want chicken and duck.”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Sausage + Bacon + Anchovy + Ham + Shrimp + Chicken] [Sauce + Cheese + Sliced Tomato + Duck]

orders.order: “I like my duck with tomato! But my friend doesn't like duck, so make them a pizza with the rest of the meats you have!”
orders.clarification: “Two pizzas: one with duck and tomato for me, and the other with all the meats you have except duck for my friend!”

orders.order: “I had the most delicious roast duck with a balsamic fig glaze when I went to France! I only wished it didn't have balsamic in it...and that it was on a pizza...”
orders.clarification: “I think the dish would've tasted better with only duck and fig. With sauce and cheese instead of balsamic vinegar.”

orders.order: “I love Cucurbita pepo. If I can't have it, I'll opt for Anas platyrhynchos. Good thing you have both!”
orders.clarification: “The scientific name for zucchini is Cucurbita pepo and duck is Anas platyrhynchos! Put them on a pizza!”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Sliced Tomato + Zucchini + Duck

orders.order: “I'm on a diet, but it's my cheat day and I want a duck pizza. Add some tomato and zucchini to make it a little healthier. Uncut.”
orders.clarification: “I want duck, sliced tomato, and zucchini on my pizza! Don't cut it.”

orders.order: “I don't want my friends to know I'm here, but make me an artichoke pizza swimming with duck. Sliced twice.”
orders.clarification: “All my friends hate artichoke! I love it. Just give me some with duck. Cut it into four slices.”
orders.note: (Cut the pizza twice.)

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Sausage + Olive + Bell Pepper + Bacon + Artichoke + Duck

orders.order: “Gimme a Fruity Pig. But with duck instead of ham and artichoke instead of pineapple. Make it dark!”
orders.clarification: “I hope you don't mind a couple of substitutions. I want a pizza with pep, sausage, olive, bell pepper, bacon, duck, and artichoke! Well done.”

orders.order: “Ahhh, there's nothing tastier than peach on tomato sauce!”
orders.clarification: “Savory tomato sauce and sweet peach on dough will make my heart sing!”

orders.order: “I usually like my peaches charred, so can you put it on a cheese pizza and double-bake it?”
orders.clarification: “I'm asking if you can make a peach pizza and put it through the oven twice.”
orders.note: (Bake the pizza twice.)

orders.order: “A hero can be anyone. Even an Ovenist doing something as simple and reassuring as serving a peach pizza to let you know that the world hasn't ended.”
orders.clarification: “You are my hero if you bake dough, sauce, and cheese with peach!”

orders.order: “I'm feeling like a princess today. Could you bake me a peach pizza?”
orders.clarification: “I want to be a peach princess eating peach on dough, sauce, and cheese!”

orders.order: “I may wish for an apple or an orange, but I will get a peach. A peach pizza.”
orders.clarification: “Yesterday is history, tomorrow is a mystery, but today is a gift with dough, sauce, cheese, and the delicious peach topping!”

orders.order: “I had a friend named James who had this GIANT peach! Anyway, I'll have two peach pizzas for my GIANT appetite! Double-baked!”
orders.clarification: “Please bake two doughs with sauce, cheese, and peach. Put them through the oven twice!”

orders.order: “Peaches, peaches, peaches, oh, I love you! Triple order of peach pizzas, please”
orders.clarification: “Give me three cheese pizzas, all topped with peach!”

orders.order: “I'll have a peach pizza with sausage. It's a bold move, but I'm a bold person”
orders.clarification: “Let's see what happens when savory meets sweet with a pizza topped with sausage and peach!”

orders.order: “You know what's sad? Living life without ever having eaten pizza with peach and olive. I'll have two of those, please.”
orders.clarification: “I can't go on without two doughs with sauce, cheese, peach, and olive!”

entries.recipe: [Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Peach] [Sauce + Cheese + Olive + Peach]

orders.order: “Give me two peach pizzas. One with pepperoni and the other with olive.”
orders.clarification: “One peach and pepperoni pizza. One peach and olive pizza.”

orders.order: “Do you know what looks good together? Peach and bell pepper on pizza!”
orders.clarification: “I'm ready to eat peach and bell pepper on dough, sauce, and cheese!”

orders.order: “I love me that salty-sweet flavor of a bacon and peach pizza!”
orders.clarification: “You know what's good? Bacon and peach on dough, sauce, and cheese!”

orders.order: “I want a sauce that's the color of blue and yellow mixed together. With sweet peach and pineapple on top. No cheese!”
orders.clarification: “I'm craving dough with green pesto sauce, peach, and pineapple! Don't put cheese!”

orders.order: “I like anchovy, but it can be too fishy for me sometimes, I think peach would help tone down the flavor.”
orders.clarification: “I need sweet peach to mask the fishy anchovy flavor on a cheese pizza!”

orders.order: “I don't want to burst your pizza bubble or anything, but now is not the time for sauce. I want cheese and peach...and mushroom...and eggplant.”
orders.clarification: “Please make a cheesy flatbread with peach, mushroom, and eggplant!”

orders.order: “Everybody wants this. Everybody wants to be like me, eating a peach pizza with chicken.”
orders.clarification: “By all means, move at a glacial pace as you make my cheese pizza with peach and chicken. You know how that thrills me.”

orders.order: “Peach fuzz is meant to protect the fruit from insects! I just use garlic to repel insects. One peach and garlic pie, please!”
orders.clarification: “If it works, it works! Bake one cheese pizza with peach and garlic!”

orders.order: “Two sweet fruits prepare for battle on different sides of a pizza. Peach and fig!”
orders.clarification: “Don't let peach and fig touch on my cheese pizza! Put peach on one side and fig on the other.”

orders.order: “If I were a zucchini, I would definitely want to have a pizza sleepover with peach and onion.”
orders.clarification: “I'm just saying that peach, onion, and zucchini seem like besties ready for a cheesy sleepover on dough and sauce!”

orders.order: “Close your eyes...and imagine what it's like to eat a peach pizza with artichoke... Sounds good, right? That's what I'm trying to do today!”
orders.clarification: “Please don't let me down! I want to eat peach and artichoke on dough, sauce, and cheese!”

orders.order: “I want baked apple bread! Don't leave it in the oven too long, or else it'll be hard to eat.”
orders.clarification: “Just put apple on dough and run it through the oven once. That should work!”

orders.order: “Show me what apples look like on a saucy flatbread. Eight slices. Woo!”
orders.clarification: “Oh! Um, just sauce and apple! But cut it in half four times.”
orders.note: (Cut the pizza four times.)

orders.order: “I'd like dough, covered with only cheese and the noblest of fruit.”
orders.clarification: “The noblest of fruit, as one author put it–that's apples. Just cheese and apple on dough, thanks.”

orders.order: “Apples and cheese on bread is my jam! My friend said I should try it with pesto. Could I get it on just one half, though?”
orders.clarification: “I'm not sold on pesto with cheese and apples... So please keep the pesto on one side.”

orders.order: “It's funny that the Big Apple is famous for its pizza, because that's what I want on my pizza!”
orders.clarification: “That's right: I want a cheese pizza with apple on it. And don't you fuhgeddaboudit.”

orders.order: “Hm...apple pie...apple pizza...apple...goodness!”
orders.clarification: “Sauce, cheese, and apple will do for me. Thank you!”

orders.order: “Nothing says cozy like a warm apple pie!”
orders.clarification: “Warm up an apple pizza in the oven for me, please!”

orders.order: “Imagine a pizza topped with warm apples, melty cheese, and sauce... So artsy, right?”
orders.clarification: “I'd like a beautifully crafted apple pizza!”

orders.order: “You know how some people put cheese on apple pie? Well, I want apples on my cheese pie!”
orders.clarification: “Gimme a cheese pizza with apple, please!”

orders.order: “A pizza with some sweet, crunchy fruit on it. That sure sounds a-peel-ing!”
orders.clarification: “Get it? Like an apple peel? Sigh... Just give me a cheese pizza with apple on it.”

orders.order: “I wanted to give my teacher an apple. But then I thought, "Maybe it would taste even better on pizza!"”
orders.clarification: “Can I get a cheese pizza with apple on it? My teacher deserves it!”

orders.order: “*yawn* I could really go for an apple pizza...d-double baked!”
orders.clarification: “Yeah, yeah! A uh... *yawn* cheese pizza with apple on...top...dark crust *yawn*”
orders.note: (Run the pizza through the oven twice.)

orders.order: “You can put apples on pizza? Can I have two of those?”
orders.clarification: “Double order of apple pizzas!”

orders.order: “Pizza is truly the apple of my eye... So give me apple pizzas, one for each eye!”
orders.clarification: “That's two pizzas with apple. It's not like I'm missing an eye or anything!”

orders.order: “I'm being bad and breaking my diet. So let's go all out with three cheese pizzas, but add apple.”
orders.clarification: “Add apples to three cheese pizzas to make them a little more guilt-free. YOLO!”

orders.order: “An apple a day can keep the blues away, but I think having it with pep really does the trick!”
orders.clarification: “Oh, I was just saying that nothing makes me happier than pepperoni and apple on a pizza!”

orders.order: “I heard some sausages have apples in them! But what if we had both of those on a pizza?”
orders.clarification: “Let's give it a try! One cheese pizza with apple and sausage, please.”

orders.order: “Can I get a mushroom pizza with apple and pepperoni on one half? I know, it sounds weird...but my friend insists it's good.”
orders.clarification: “Just a cheese pizza with mushroom on it, but then put apple and pepperoni on one half.”

entries.recipe: Cheese + (Tomato Sauce + Pepperoni + Mushroom) + (Pesto Sauce + Sausage + Apple)

orders.order: “Hello, friend! Give me one half mushroom-pepperoni on tomato sauce, one half apple-sausage on pesto!”
orders.clarification: “That's pepperoni and mushroom on the tomato sauce side, apple and sausage on the pesto side!”

orders.order: “Gimme three apple, onion, and pepperoni pizzas! 24 slices total!”
orders.clarification: “Just like my apples, I like my pizza slices small. Cut three pizzas with apple, onion, and pep into eight slices each!”
orders.note: (Cut each pizza four times.)

orders.order: “The smell of apples, onions, and mushrooms being cooked... Man, my mouth is watering already!”
orders.clarification: “An apple, onion, and mushroom pizza-scented candle would be AMAZING! But the pizza itself will do.”

orders.order: “I love pizzas with bacon and apple. But if you put apples in the oven too long, they become soft and lose their crunch... Let's put the two toppings on two different pizzas!”
orders.clarification: “How about a cheese pizza with apples and another with bacon? Then you can keep the bacon one crispy without the mushy apples!”

entries.recipe: [Tomato Sauce + Cheese + Onion + Apple] [Pesto Sauce + Cheese + Bacon + Apple]

orders.order: “Alright! Let me have one pesto pizza with apples and bacon, one regular pizza with apples and onions!”
orders.clarification: “That's two apple pizzas: one with bacon on pesto, the other with onions on tomato sauce!”

orders.order: “I'd like an apple pizza, please! Both the pine- and non-pine varieties, preferably.”
orders.clarification: “A cheese pizza with both apple and pineapple. That'll do it for me.”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Pepperoni + Sausage + Mushroom + Ham + Apple

orders.order: “CHOP! CHOP CHOP! Apple, pepperoni, sausage, mushroom, ham! Slice it, dice it, put it on my pizza!”
orders.clarification: “Apple, pepperoni, sausage, mushroom, and ham on a cheese pizza! CHOP CHOP!!!”

orders.order: “I'm trying to decide between apples or basil... Maybe both on different sides of the pie?”
orders.clarification: “Let's do a cheese pizza with apple on one half and basil on the other.”

orders.order: “Basil and apples. Make that two to go.”
orders.clarification: “What can I say? I've got simple taste. Two cheese pizzas with basil and apples, please.”

orders.order: “Did you know that apples and eggplants float in water? And anchovies LIVE in the water! Y'know what else they have in common?”
orders.clarification: “They all taste good on a cheese pizza! Make sure it has lots of eggplant, apple, and anchovy!”

orders.order: “This may be corny, perhaps even a bit hammy... But you're apple-lutely my favorite pizzeria in town!”
orders.clarification: “Okay, enough puns. I'll take a cheese pizza with corn, ham, and apple, please.”

orders.order: “Chopped chicken and apple go well in a salad! But what about on pizza?”
orders.clarification: “Give me chicken and apple on cheese, please!”

orders.order: “I want a pizza with sweet apple chicken sausages.”
orders.clarification: “You only have apple, chicken, and sausage separately? That's fine, just put 'em on a cheese pizza.”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Olive + Sliced Tomato + Fig + Apple

orders.order: “My grandpa used to grow all kinds of amazing things in his orchard! Tomatoes, figs, apples, olives...”
orders.clarification: “Say, wouldn't it be swell if I had all those on a cheese pizza?”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Pineapple + Eggplant + Fig + Zucchini + Apple

orders.order: “Obviously, pineapples and apples are fruits. But did you know figs, eggplant, and zucchini are fruits, too?”
orders.clarification: “The more you know! Can I please get a cheese pizza with pineapple, apple, zucchini, eggplant, and fig?”

entries.recipe: Sauce + Cheese + Olive + Fig + Peach + Apple

orders.order: “If the apple doesn't fall far from the tree, then I only want ingredients that grow from trees on my pizza.”
orders.clarification: “Olives, figs, and peaches grow from trees! Add 'em to my apple pizza, too.”

orders.order: “I heard you have scallops now. Just scallops. Nothing else. Let's see what it's all about.”
orders.clarification: “I want to judge it on its own merits.”

orders.order: “My favorite part of a day at the beach is the food. One scallop pizza please.”
